claims.value: StdMoE_1b14b_1T_Preanneal is a 1B-active/14B-total parameter Mixture-of-Experts model, serving as the pre-annealing baseline for the EMO experiment. It uses 128 experts (127 routed, 1 shared) with k=8 active per token, pretrained on 1T tokens of the OLMoE mix without annealing.
claims.evidence: 1B-active / 14B-total parameter Mixture-of-Experts model (128 experts: 127 routed + 1 shared, k=8 active per token) pretrained on 1T tokens of the OLMoE pretraining mix with the standard MoE objective. No annealing applied.
